title: Time-Dependent Logarithmic Perturbation Theory for Quantum Dynamics: Formulation and Applications
summary: We present a time-dependent extension of logarithmic perturbation theory for nonrelativistic quantum dynamics governed by the Schrödinger equation, in which the logarithm of the wave function is expanded in powers of a coupling constant. The resulting hierarchy of equations defining the perturbative corrections is governed by a gauge-rotated Hamiltonian of the unperturbed system and leads to closed-integral expressions for the time-dependent corrections based on Duhamel's formula. This closed-integral structure of corrections is a hallmark of time-independent logarithmic perturbation theory…
